name: DeMarker Pending 2_5
summary: This EA uses the DeMarker oscillator to identify overbought and oversold market conditions, then places pending orders at calculated price levels expecting a mean reversion. It employs a pending order strategy with configurable DeMarker thresholds and order placement distances. The EA automates trade entry when DeMarker signals extreme conditions, targeting price reversals back toward the mean.
summary_zh: 该EA使用DeMarker振荡器识别市场的超买和超卖状态，然后在计算的价格水平放置挂单以期均值回归。它采用挂单策略，具有可配置的DeMarker阈值和挂单距离。当DeMarker信号显示极端条件时，EA自动执行交易入场，目标是从极端水平回归均值。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于DeMarker振荡器的均值回归逻辑，当DeMarker指标进入超买区域（通常高于0.7）时放置卖出挂单，当进入超卖区域（通常低于0.3）时放置买入挂单。入场条件依赖于DeMarker阈值参数的设定，指标穿越极端水平时触发挂单放置逻辑。出场条件通过止盈和止损参数控制，持仓等待价格从极端水平回归。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏复合仓位或风险比例计算，仅依赖静态手数设定。挂单距离参数决定了入场价格与当前市价的偏移量，这为价格波动提供了一定的缓冲空间。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a mean reversion logic using the DeMarker oscillator, placing sell pending orders when DeMarker enters the overbought zone (typically above 0.7) and buy pending orders when it enters the oversold zone (typically below 0.3). Entry conditions rely on DeMarker threshold parameter settings, with pending order placement triggered when the indicator crosses extreme levels. Exit conditions are controlled through take profit and stop loss parameters, holding positions while waiting for price to revert from extreme levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management lacks compounding or risk-proportional calculation, relying solely on static lot size settings. The pending order distance parameter determines the offset between the entry price and the current market price, providing some buffer for price volatility.

parameters.name: DeMarker_Overbought
parameters.description: 超买阈值，高于此值放置卖出挂单
parameters.description_en: Overbought threshold; place sell pending above this

parameters.name: DeMarker_Oversold
parameters.description: 超卖阈值，低于此值放置买入挂单
parameters.description_en: Oversold threshold; place buy pending below this

parameters.name: Pending_Distance
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价格的点数偏移
parameters.description_en: Pending order offset from current price in points

parameters.name: Order_Expiration
parameters.description: 挂单过期时间（0为不过期）

pros: 使用DeMarker振荡器作为均值回归信号，逻辑清晰且基于成熟技术指标
采用挂单方式入场，避免了市价成交的滑点风险，同时提供了价格缓冲
可配置的超买超卖阈值允许交易者根据不同市场环境灵活调整策略参数
pros_en: Uses the DeMarker oscillator for mean reversion signals, with clear logic based on a well-established technical indicator
Employs pending orders for entry, avoiding market execution slippage risks while providing a price buffer
Configurable overbought/oversold thresholds allow traders to flexibly adjust strategy parameters for different market conditions
cons: 固定手数交易缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金和波动率自适应调整风险敞口
均值回归策略在强趋势市场中会持续逆势交易，可能导致连续止损
缺少新K线检测机制，可能在同一信号上重复下单造成过度交易
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adapt risk exposure based on account equity and volatility
Mean reversion strategy will continuously trade against the trend in strong trending markets, potentially causing consecutive stop losses
Lacks new bar detection mechanism, potentially placing duplicate orders on the same signal leading to overtrading
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额百分比或ATR波动率自动调整手数
添加趋势过滤器（如移动平均线），在强趋势方向与信号相反时禁止逆势入场
加入新K线检测和挂单状态检查，避免重复下单和订单管理混乱
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance percentage or ATR volatility
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average) to prevent counter-trend entries when the strong trend direction opposes the signal
Implement new bar detection and pending order status checks to avoid duplicate order placement and order management confusion

risk_points: 均值回归策略在单边趋势行情中面临持续逆势亏损风险
固定手数不考虑账户资金变化，可能在小账户中造成过大风险
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy faces continuous counter-trend loss risk in strong one-sided trending markets
Fixed lot size does not account for account equity changes, potentially creating excessive risk on small accounts
